Name: Jeush
Summary: Jeush was a son of Esau by Aholibamah, and one of the dukes of Edom.
KeyStory: Jeush is named with his brothers Jaalam and Korah among Aholibamah's sons and among Edom's dukes.
RelatedPeople: Esau; Aholibamah; Jaalam; Korah, Son of Esau
LifeLesson: God's story keeps moving through families we know almost nothing about — and He knows them all.
